articles.summary: The share of renters who convert to homeownership fell from 7.2% in 2009 to 3.9% in 2025, a decline of 46%, according to a new TransUnion (NYSE: TRU) analysis. The finding reflects a broader trend: economic pressures are leading fewer consumers to buy homes and vehicles, forcing insurers to compete for a shrinking pool of new policyholders.
articles.title: TransUnion Finds Nearly 50% Drop in Renters Becoming Homeowners, Reshaping Property Insurance Market

articles.summary: TransUnion (NYSE: TRU) announced today that its TruVision Resident Screening solution will provide cash flow intelligence for rental applicants. Expected in 2027, the product enhancement will increase consumers’ access to rental housing and help property managers discover a greater number of qualified applicants for their rental units.
articles.title: TransUnion to Add Nova Credit Cash Flow Intelligence to Resident Screening, Helping Operators Approve More Qualified Renters
